title: 36 Hours: Lake Como, Italy
abstract: The views — from above, the shore or a boat — may steal the show, but there’s more to do in this area of northern Italy than simply gaze at the scenery.

title: 36 Hours in Madrid
abstract: Explore everything from culture to cuisine during a weekend in the Spanish capital.

title: 36 Hours in Nice
abstract: On the southeast coast of France, Nice welcomes travelers with alluring restaurants, a broad beach, sherbet-hued buildings and gay-friendly night life.

title: 36 Hours in Nice, France
abstract: A city for all budgets, Nice now buzzes with an energy and diversity that often surpasses its rivals on the Riviera.

title: 36 Hours in Glasgow
abstract: Drawing on its rich musical and industrial heritage, Glasgow has re-emerged as a vibrant hub of culture, food and night life.

title: 36 Hours in Glasgow
abstract: Whether you’re looking for art or music, shops or nature, a cup of tea or a dram of whisky, you can find it during a weekend in this city in western Scotland.

title: 36 Hours in Charlotte, N.C.
abstract: Explore the “Queen City,” where downtown is Uptown, the Old South is new and the attractions range from bike routes to the Nascar Hall of Fame.
